noah_types: FYI customer reported duplicate invoices when using the sync SDK (requests backend). seems different from the async timeout replay thread. repro attached.

lee_py_sdk: looking. quick repro I ran:```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='sk-...')
with open('payload.bin','rb') as f:
    r = c.post('/v1/invoices', data=f, timeout=1)
```
They hit a socket timeout due to a slow upstream and we see two POSTs delivered.

maria_devex: ugh. how is requests causing a second POST?

sam_runtime: classic: requests' HTTPAdapter + urllib3 will retry on idempotent methods by default when certain connection errors occur, but we also have our own retry layer. More importantly, when the body is a file-like and not rewindable, requests sometimes buffers it into a temporary file and ends up re-sending on internal retries. Our client-level guard to prevent replay when body isn't seekable isn't triggering because the check looks for .seek attribute but our wrapper provides a .seek shim that raises on call. Edgecase.

noah_types: also want to flag typing ergonomics: Client.post signature currently is def post(self, path: str, data=None, json=None, **kwargs) -> Any. We should be explicit: data: Optional[Union[bytes,str,BinaryIO,Iterable[bytes]]], idempotency_key: Optional[str]=None, buffer_retries: bool=False. Adding precise types will help users and prevent accidental streaming of generator objects.

lee_py_sdk: proposed remediation:
- change default: do NOT retry non-idempotent methods at the transport layer. Only allow retry if idempotency_key present or buffer_retries=True.
- tighten our "is_replayable_body" check: actually attempt to call seek/tell in a safe sandbox (catch OSError) instead of just hasattr.
- expose `buffer_retries` param on Client to auto-buffer to memory up to 512KB (configurable) so small files can be safely replayed. Larger bodies must opt-in with buffer_retries=True or supply idempotency_key.
- remove any duplicate retry logic in requests adapter by setting urllib3 Retry(total=0) on our session for non-idempotent methods.

maria_devex: can we make this a non-breaking change for most users? need migration guidance and a deprecation window if we change default buffering semantics.

sam_runtime: yes. Plan: ship a patch that keeps current behavior behind feature-flag `sdk.legacy_sync_retries=true`. Default for 1.14+ will be False. We'll include a log.warn when the legacy flag is true about upcoming change.

noah_types: also adding a TypedDict for RetryPolicy in the client config would be helpful: {"max_attempts": int, "backoff_base": float, "status_codes": List[int]} and update docs/py-sdk/reference types. I'll draft type stubs PR.

ops_bot: issue-tracker: created #4621 "sync-sdk: prevent accidental replay of streaming bodies (requests backend)" and attached repro gist https://gist.github.com/YYY

lee_py_sdk: unit tests to add:
- open file-as-body that raises on seek -> timeout -> verify no second POST sent and TimeoutError propagates.
- open file with seekable -> timeout -> buffer_retries True -> verify retry occurs.
- generator/iterator body -> no retry and helpful ValueError telling user to provide idempotency_key or buffer_retries.
- integration test ensuring urllib3 Retry not double-applying.

maria_devex: docs: add FAQ entry "Why did my POST replay?" and examples for idempotency usage and buffer_retries. Also update migration guide and changelog for 1.13 -> 1.14.

lee_py_sdk: small API note: we'll add a typed param `idempotency_key: Optional[str]=None` to all mutating methods (post/put/patch/delete) and soft-deprecate passing idempotency header in headers dict in favor of param (still supported).

sam_runtime: metrics: emit `sdk.sync.replay_attempt` and `sdk.sync.replay_blocked` with tags method=/path and flag=buffered|blocked. that will let us see downstream impact.

noah_types: opened PRs: types PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/801 and bugfix PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/802. please review for typing and behavioral change.

ops_bot: infra: feature-flag `sdk.legacy_sync_retries` toggled to false on hosted prod.

maria_devex: can someone reach out to the customer and offer 1:1 support + recommended pattern (idempotency_key or buffer small files)?

lee_py_sdk: i'll follow up. merging once CI and tests added. leaving a note to customer about pinning to 1.13.x if they need old behavior.

sam_runtime: after merge, monitor sdk.sync.replay_blocked and escalate if spike: runbooks updated.

noah_types: thanks team. small win for typing & safety :) :rocket:
